What Is Home Refurbishment?

Home refurbishment improves an existing interior while keeping the main structure. Floors, wall finishes, lighting, storage, fixtures and furniture can all be updated around a better room plan.

It is more focused than a complete home redesign and lighter than architectural work. The aim is to make the home feel renewed without rebuilding every room or changing the building itself.

The final scope can be as simple as a room refresh or as broad as a coordinated whole-home upgrade.

Keep the structure.
Change the experience.

Selective work
Retain sound elementsImprove weak layoutsUpdate visible finishesCoordinate new details

What’s Included

A practical refurbishment scope built around the rooms, surfaces and systems that will make the greatest difference.

Scroll through the complete scope.

01

Room-by-Room Refresh

Focused updates for bedrooms, lounges, dining rooms and everyday family spaces.

02

Full-Floor Makeovers

Connected rooms planned as one phase with consistent finishes and a clear work sequence.

03

Surface & Finish Upgrades

Flooring, wall treatments, ceilings, paint and hardware selected to work together.

04

Kitchen & Bathroom Refurbishment

Cabinetry, worktops, tiles, fixtures and storage updated around retained services where practical.

05

Lighting & Electrical Refresh

New light layers, fixtures, switches and practical power points coordinated room by room.

06

Furniture & Styling

Existing and new pieces composed into a more comfortable, finished interior.

07

Space Re-planning

Furniture positions and selected non-structural changes improve flow and everyday use.

08

Storage & Joinery Upgrades

Wardrobes, media walls, shelving and fitted storage designed for the room.

Refurbishment vs Full Redesign

Both improve the home. The difference is how much of the existing interior stays in place.

Focused upgrade

Refurbishment

Upgrade what exists with selected finish, fixture and layout changes. It is faster, costs less and causes less disruption.

Complete overhaul

Complete Redesign

Rework the full interior direction with major layout changes, a broader design scope and a higher budget.

Our Design Process

Five clear steps define what stays, what changes and how the refreshed home will come together.

01

Consultation & Requirements

We discuss the rooms, priorities, budget and the level of disruption that works for you.

02

Site Measurement

We measure the space and record its condition, services and elements worth retaining.

03

Concept & Layout Design

We improve the plan and establish a clear direction for the upgraded interior.

04

Material & Furniture Selection

Finishes, fixtures, furniture and joinery are coordinated within the agreed budget.

05

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

You receive the approved design, specifications and key 3D views before work starts.

Pricing

Your initial consultation and site survey are free. We then provide an exact fixed quote for the agreed scope.

Home Refurbishment FAQs

Clear answers on scope, timing, living through the work and the value of planning first.

Refurbishment refreshes finishes, fixtures, furniture and selected layouts while keeping most of the existing structure. Renovation can involve heavier demolition, services and structural changes.

A room refresh can take 1 to 3 weeks. A floor or whole-home scope may take 4 to 12 weeks depending on materials, joinery and how the work is phased.
